name: Watermelon
description: A cheerful, sunburnt man in his mid forties who is the neighbourhood watermelon-seed-spitting champion and sings zydeco.
build: A sturdy, barrel-chested man's build: broad shoulders, a round belly, strong arms, legs of ordinary length, standing upright.
face: Fair skin burned bright red on the face, nose, neck and arms, with a pale strip across the forehead, blue eyes under sandy brows, a round nose, puffed full cheeks, a wide mouth with a gap between the front teeth.
hair: Short sandy-blond hair in a buzz cut, a pale strip of forehead beneath the hairline.
outfit: Faded denim bib overalls with one strap hanging unbuttoned, over a bright white tank top; a large bold watermelon-slice patch in red and green on the bib; the overall legs rolled to mid-calf; bare feet in green rubber flip-flops.
performance_style: Cheery and square: feet shoulder-width apart, weight even. Both arms hang at the sides, the character-right and character-left hands open, empty, every finger visible beside the thighs. Head level, cheeks puffed, lips pursed as if ready to spit a seed.
location: A backyard picnic in hot midday sun: a long picnic table heaped with watermelon slices, a chalk line and a tape measure on the lawn running to the bottom of the frame, a cooler, a fence and string lights behind.
recognition_cues: denim bib overalls with one strap hanging
a bright red sunburn on face and arms
a big watermelon-slice patch on the bib
avoid: a watermelon slice in the hands in the key art: his hands are empty

sing.intent: Zydeco vocal loop: two-step side to side, bring the mic in the character-right hand to the mouth, rub the character-left knuckles up and down the bib like a washboard, then return to the square stance. The mouth must visibly open and change shape across the loop so he unmistakably reads as singing.

animations.flinch: Brief start at a loud backyard sound: the shoulders jump, the torso draws back and both open hands rise to chest height, then he settles back to the opening stance. No opponent, strike or contact.
animations.guard: One-shot self-protection: set the feet a little wider, bring the character-left forearm across the chest with the character-right hand open at the hip, and hold a steady finish. Not combat.
animations.entrance: One-shot entrance: waddle in cheerfully in the flip-flops, stop square to the front and settle into the stance.
